name: warming up in lunge (four)
description: Lunge warm-up, part 4: a runner's lunge with both hands on the floor and the rear leg extended.
instructions: Step one foot forward and place both hands on the floor beside it.
Extend the rear leg with its toes on the floor and lift the rear knee.
Keep your spine long and gently move your hips forward and back to warm the front hip and inner thigh.
Step back, switch legs, and repeat without bouncing.
